name: Tan Ky House
summary: A tube house at 101 Nguyễn Thái Học. The ground floor is the visit, and the family lives upstairs. The fee is the ancient-town ticket, which is check on arrival. A visitor page prints 08:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:45 every day. Confirm that split day.
timeNeeded: A short visit. Exact minutes are check on arrival.
